_comment: Claude Code implementation handoff for W4 UX/UI changes. This is an implementation task, not a review-only task.
title: Implement W4 UX/UI corrections on the production-facing surface per freeze doc and latest review issues
objective: Implement the W4 UX/UI design corrections on the production-facing review surface. Do not stop at reviewing docs. Modify the real UI so it follows the frozen Export + Configurator design and the latest user review comments.

issues_to_fix.title: Export Config + Preview must preserve PoC-level column control
requirements: User must be able to select fields and reorder columns before export.
This must work for both export without a template and export from a selected template.
After selecting a template, user must still be able to adjust columns for that run.
The adjustment panel must be inline on the export page, not popup-first or modal-first.
The design must align with the frozen two-path export flow in UX-FREEZE-EXPORT-CONFIGURATOR.md.

issues_to_fix.title: Company management entry and AP/AR split
requirements: The company-management entry labeled COA should be reframed toward broader Settings.
AP and AR data management/import flows should be separated instead of merged into one generic vendor/customer area.
Use the sample references below to shape the separation intent:

issues_to_fix.title: Additional customer template families must be reflected in the UI direction
requirements: Use the customer sample packs under private_data/poc/Comp_1/template/excelformat as implementation references where the requirement is already clear.
Do not bury ambiguous items; keep UI work aligned only to the low-ambiguity formats already promoted into Epic 10 planning.

implementation_expectations: 1. Implement on src/frontend/main-ux-ui.html and any directly supporting frontend files/tests only.
2. Keep the Export flow aligned with the freeze doc: Quick Export and Template Export, with inline column adjustment and preview-before-download.
3. Preserve PoC-style column selection and drag-drop reordering instead of reducing the flow to a locked template or popup-only export.
4. Keep Template Configurator as the persistent setup area and Export adjustment as the per-run area.
5. Reflect the company-management AP/AR separation direction in the production-facing UX where it already exists in scope; do not perform a broad unrelated admin redesign.
6. Update or add focused Playwright coverage for the changed UX paths where practical.
minimum_acceptance_criteria: Export UI on the production-facing surface supports field selection and column reordering.
Quick Export works as a no-template path with adjustable columns.
Template Export still allows per-run column adjustment after template selection.
Export adjustment is inline on the page, not modal-first.
Company-management UX no longer communicates the relevant area as only COA if that area is touched in this pass.
AP and AR separation is represented clearly if the relevant company-management section is touched in this pass.
Changes are implemented on the production-facing surface, not only in demo/reference files.

report_sections: What remains blocked or out of scope

final_instruction_to_claude: Implement the UX/UI changes. Do not answer with a review-only summary. If something cannot be completed because of a real blocker, say exactly what remains blocked and why.
